name: CRM Demo · Thermal
note: Source of truth for the CRM Demo design system. tailwind.config.ts reads the scales from here; src/styles/tokens.css carries the same values as CSS custom properties (regenerate with `node design/build-tokens.mjs`). Contrast figures are WCAG 2.x ratios, computed and then re-measured from rendered pixels (see REDESIGN.md).

ink.usage: The one neutral family: cool slate. Text, borders, surfaces. Replaces Tailwind gray/slate/zinc/neutral/stone.

ember.usage: The one accent: heat. Primary action, the active nav item, focus ring, a hot lead. Never decoration, never a section background.

steel.usage: The cold end of the heat ramp, and the information hue. Replaces Tailwind blue/indigo/sky/cyan/violet/purple/fuchsia, so stray hues fall into one calm family.

moss.usage: Status only: done, connected, won. Replaces green/emerald/teal/lime.

amber.usage: Status only: waiting, warm lead, needs attention. Replaces amber/yellow.

brick.usage: Status only: failed, destructive. Replaces red/rose/pink.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground. ink-900 on it 16.4:1 (light); ink-100 on dark 15.6:1.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, inputs on a card, code.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, placeholders. 5.4:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on surface-sunken; never paler.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between groups (Tailwind `border`). Not a text colour.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary button, the active nav mark, links (Tailwind `primary`). White on it 5.0:1; ink-950 on the dark action 6.4:1.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav background. ember-700 text on it 6.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2 px focus ring with 2 px offset, every focusable thing.

tokens.name: whatsapp-bubble
tokens.usage: A sent WhatsApp message: WhatsApp's own outgoing tints. Never a bright-green fill under white text (#25D366 with white was 2.0:1).

tokens.name: whatsapp-accent
tokens.usage: WhatsApp-green text and icons (channel status, 'meeting ready'). 5.5:1 on surface-sunken light; 7.8:1 on dark surfaces.

heat.usage: The lead temperature ramp, the one place colour carries data. Always printed with a word (Cold, Cool, Warm, Hot), never colour alone.

chart.usage: Categorical order for charts. Series 1 is always the accent; the rest are the status and steel hues, never a rainbow.

hebrew.usage: Every Hebrew string (dir=rtl). Geist has no Hebrew glyphs.

type.numerals: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every figure in a table, KPI or chart label.

roles.name: display
roles.usage: The landing hero headline only. 40px at 390.

roles.name: page-title
roles.usage: The one title of an app page.

roles.name: body
roles.usage: Reading text in the app and legal pages.

roles.name: ui
roles.usage: Buttons, nav, table cells, form labels.

roles.name: caption
roles.usage: Meta, helper text, badges. text-muted at minimum.

roles.name: kpi
roles.usage: One figure on a stat card, tabular.

spacing.usage: 4 px base. Use only these steps (Tailwind 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24).

radius.rule: Controls are 6, surfaces are 10, status pills and avatars are full. Nothing else.

shadow.rule: Elevation means it floats above the page (popover, dialog, sticky bar). Cards on the page use a border, not a shadow.

motion.rule: Motion says something changed. 120 ms for hover/press, 200 ms for panels, 400 ms max for an entrance; ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1). Everything is static under prefers-reduced-motion.
